data_store_publicly_routable.title: Data Store Publicly Routable
data_store_publicly_routable.description: Data store is directly reachable from public network (insecure when true). The data tier must not be addressable from untrusted networks.

data_tier_crossing_only_via_app_pep.title: Data-Tier Crossing Only via App PEP
data_tier_crossing_only_via_app_pep.description: Every ingress path into the data tier transits the application-tier policy enforcement point; no alternate non-PEP path exists.

per_workload_db_identity_used.title: Per-Workload DB Identity Used
per_workload_db_identity_used.description: Each workload authenticates to the data store with its own least-privilege service identity (IAM auth / SPIFFE SVID / per-app DB role) - not a shared superuser.

data_tier_credentials_short_lived.title: Data-Tier Credentials Short-Lived
data_tier_credentials_short_lived.description: Credentials used to cross the boundary are short-lived / dynamically issued (vault leases, IAM session tokens, X.509 SVIDs), not long-lived static passwords pinned in config.

least_privilege_db_account.title: Least-Privilege DB Account
least_privilege_db_account.description: App-tier grants are scoped to per-query need - no ALL PRIVILEGES, no s3:*, no +@all ~* on Redis, no superuser/db_owner/consoleAdmin. The account at the boundary holds only the verbs and objects the app actually uses.

bulk_read_volume_anomaly_alerted.title: Bulk-Read Volume Anomaly Alerted
bulk_read_volume_anomaly_alerted.description: Volume/rate anomalies (rows-read-per-minute, full-table-scan bursts, large result-set transfers) emit alerts on bulk-read deviations consistent with T1213.

privileged_access_via_pam_with_session_r.title: Privileged Access via PAM with Session Recording
privileged_access_via_pam_with_session_r.description: DBA / break-glass access transits a recorded PAM / jump host with MFA, time-boxed approval, and session recording. Direct DBA credentials are not held on workstations.

mgmt_paths_subject_to_same_pep_controls.title: Mgmt Paths Subject to Same PEP Controls
mgmt_paths_subject_to_same_pep_controls.description: Every management-plane path (mgmt VLAN, DBaaS support tunnel, monitoring agent, replication, backup agent) enforces the same authn/authz/inspection as the primary app-tier crossing.

data_tier_ingress_scoped_per_workload_id.title: Data-Tier Ingress Scoped Per Workload Identity
data_tier_ingress_scoped_per_workload_id.description: Ingress rules scope source to per-app workload identity (per-service SG / SPIFFE SVID / per-app IAM DB role); no flat app-tier->all-databases allow rule.

data_tier_transit_encrypted.title: Data-Tier Transit Encrypted
data_tier_transit_encrypted.description: App-to-data-store traffic crossing into the data tier is TLS-encrypted with a modern profile (TLS 1.2+); cleartext listeners disabled at the data store.

backup_destinations_in_approved_region_a.title: Backup Destinations in Approved Region and Account
backup_destinations_in_approved_region_a.description: Backups/snapshots are only written/copied/shared to pre-approved destinations within boundary trust scope (no public bucket, no untrusted cross-account share, no unrestricted region copy).

backup_egress_audited_separately.title: Backup Egress Audited Separately
backup_egress_audited_separately.description: Backup/snapshot channel emits its own audit trail (snapshot share events, backup-vault policy changes, cross-region copies) to a tamper-resistant store outside data-tier admin scope.

kms_admin_separated_from_db_admin.title: KMS Admin Separated from DB Admin
kms_admin_separated_from_db_admin.description: Principals authorised for KMS key-admin actions (ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKey, PutKeyPolicy, key export) are disjoint from principals operating the data store.

kms_key_protection_policy_enforced.title: KMS Key Protection Policy Enforced
kms_key_protection_policy_enforced.description: Wrapping KMS/HSM key has automated rotation enabled per documented cryptoperiod AND multi-party approval / pause window for destructive lifecycle (scheduled deletion, disable, export).

data_tier_crossings_audit_logged_to_tamp.title: Data-Tier Crossings Audit-Logged to Tamper-Resistant Store
data_tier_crossings_audit_logged_to_tamp.description: Every data-tier crossing (successful connection, failed auth, DDL, DML at sensitivity threshold) is logged and ships to a tamper-resistant store outside DBA administrative scope.

failed_auth_and_admin_events_alerted.title: Failed Auth and Admin Events Alerted
failed_auth_and_admin_events_alerted.description: Failed authentication attempts and privileged / admin events (role/grant changes, DDL, bulk-read anomalies) generate alerts on a defined path (SIEM, pager).
